campaign: Colibri transfer: shared capability, accuracy and end-to-end inference improvements
doctrine:
Owned worktree: C:/Users/jeffm/overgo_colibri, branch codex/overgo_colibri, lane colibri, worker codex-colibri-owner. The user explicitly authorizes this lane to expand and implement the Colibri transfer plan, including shared inference, performance, accuracy and GUI capabilities, and to commit here. Do not write or push master or other worktrees. docs/plan.json is this lane's sole live queue. docs/COLIBRI_REVIEW.md is pinned source analysis, not behavioral authority. Colibri f028d26b422144ed4a69ad9aeaee2553ce0f9572 is a concept/behavior reference; read its code and negative experiments before each transfer. No source translation without recording applicable license and provenance.

Cycle at every completed implementation boundary: (1) inspect status, HEAD, active claims and deferred obligations; resolve this lane's failed gate before new work. Pin current master and merge it through go run ./cmd/plan -prepare-merge <pinned-master-sha> -plan-projection first-parent-target, then finalize using the exact cmd/gate -merge command and source-store identity printed by that owner. If already contained, record a no-op rather than manufacture a merge. Preserve this lane's plan and completion history; never import master's queue or overwrite concurrent source. A merge conflict is resolved in this worktree with all affected acceptance retained. Do not edit an active prepared candidate. (2) Review new master capabilities, Colibri source and retained measurements; update the ready order and implementation scope for fastest total verified capability gain, accounting for implementation, acquisition, queue, verification, maintenance and integration cost. Dependencies name real producers, not bureaucratic waves. Reuse incoming fixes instead of reimplementing; reconcile a redundant row through its own verifiable acceptance, not unsupported deletion. (3) Execute one coherent ready step through common components. (4) Commit through cmd/gate with its exact plan binding, acceptance, evidence and plan update. Repeat while authorized work remains; explicit operator stop or required unavailable inputs are retained obligations. Normal replanning accompanies implementation; only a merge lands a plan-only lane commit.

Bootstrap: preserve inherited row identities across the first gated adoption while assigning their foreign owners; then use the existing scope=lane projection to omit foreign work with no completion credit. The lane never dispatches master-lead or GUI rows. This is an independent campaign, not a widening of master's capability freeze. Source-level numerical, data, compatibility and security constraints remain in force. Acquisitions use declared artifact and byte budgets; never fabricate evidence or mark a missing required model/device/browser check passed.

Implementation objective: common components with actual consumers, recipe-declared model facts and one owner per loader, cache, sampling/verifier, placement, scheduler, record and view. Extend Go/CUDA and the dependency-free workbench; migrate callers and remove displaced paths in the same coherent step. No second framework, React/Python runtime, family switches or speculative abstraction. Derive dimensions/resource choices from declarations and live availability. Preserve cancellation and caller-declared budgets; event-driven waits replace polling only when failure and no-progress paths still terminate correctly. Required constants and statistical assumptions need explicit justified policy; observations are not universal bounds.

Quality and performance: freeze independent oracles, prompts, held-out splits, tokenization, sampling, model/artifact, source and realized-residency identities. Bitwise equality where the contract promises it; declared numerical tolerances and tie rules elsewhere; never hide quality loss behind token ties. Paired end-to-end throughput, TTFT/tail gaps, memory and total useful-result cost decide optimization promotion; operation/byte counts explain the cause and propose candidates but cannot approve slower code. Report cold/repeated/rotating/replay regimes separately, raw observations and negative/no-gain results. Measure on this hardware with the existing admission owner, isolate performance while permitting independently admitted correctness work. Do not reset budgets after retries or kill other worktrees' processes.

Verification: use existing gate and hermetic/device/race/browser/model lanes, small focused development checks, exact unchanged receipt reuse and per-change dependency selection. Every acceptance must execute nonempty relevant checks; UNAVAILABLE, skips and zero matches grant no success. Planned test names are implementation obligations. Production frozen-media changes require existing per-result reconciliation; numerical identity never renews historical performance or capacity evidence. Avoid unrelated infrastructure campaigns. UI changes preserve authenticated telemetry, durable replay, semantic counts, accessible representations and current GUI integrations. Complete supervisor work through cmd/loop when running unattended; honor durable stop and worktree/session ownership. Never borrow another supervisor session. Finish each gate to a terminal outcome and preserve interrupted work.

Continuous improvement: after each result compare predicted and actual quality/cost, then revise this plan using existing records and proposal/decision owners. Keep bounded non-promotion outcomes and concrete reopen predicates. This is supervised agent-directed RSI moving toward greater autonomy, not a claim of unsupervised operation. Master remains responsible for cross-worktree integration and its own plan.

Recovery clarification: an internal defect that blocks this lane is authorized prerequisite work in this owned worktree. Release any exact affected claim, add a scoped repair with its own acceptance, and re-dispatch; do not classify an editable repository defect as an external prerequisite merely because it lies outside the current row. colibri-merge-plan-repair/do must land before the next master synchronization because the synchronization owner itself is broken. Afterwards resume the ordinary pinned-master merge and implementation cycle. Preserve explicit user stops and genuinely unavailable external prerequisites.

items.title: Push durable serving observations into the existing runtime stream

steps.title: Push durable serving observations into the existing runtime stream
steps.verify: go test ./internal/server -run '^TestRuntimeStreamDeliversServingObservation$' -count=1 && go run ./cmd/webui-lane -run '^TestWebUIBrowserServingStream$' -require 'serving stream leg'
steps.rationale: G2. Publish after durable success, one event per turn through existing stream/subscription owners. Reconnect snapshot plus cursor must neither lose nor duplicate observations; bounded slow-subscriber behavior and cancellation. Extend Activity rather than another poller. Coordinate views with incoming GUI changes.

items.title: Reuse immutable vocabulary bindings across constrained generations

steps.title: Reuse immutable vocabulary bindings across constrained generations
steps.verify: go test ./internal/inference -run '^TestGrammarVocabularyBindingReuse$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/sampling -run '^TestGBNFVocabularyBindingShared$' -count=1 && go test ./internal/sampling -run '^TestGBNFVocabularyHashReuse$' -count=1
steps.rationale: W3.7. Decode/hash immutable vocabulary once per runner, share the binding through existing sampling grammar APIs, keep mutable parse state private. Verify distinct grammars/concurrent callers do not contaminate one another, signatures/output unchanged, second-compile decode count zero and allocations independent of vocabulary size. Retire displaced cloning paths. Split after inspecting state.go: the persisted FNV stream includes source/root before vocabulary, so ordinary prehash composition would change signatures. Reuse the binding slice and resolve hash-once while preserving exact legacy state signatures and bounded memory across distinct grammars; do not count decoding/allocation reuse as hash-once completion. TestGBNFVocabularyHashReuse is an implementation obligation, not existing evidence. Any performance promotion still requires paired total-generation evidence.

Refuse incompatible identities/unequal lossless output; do not infer significance from one pair. Keep existing unrelated IDs stable. Costs include setup and verification.
